description.en: Essential everyday greetings, polite expressions, and farewells in Italian.
description.zh-CN: 意大利语中最核心的日常问候、礼貌用语及道别表达。

translations.zh-CN: 你好 / 再见 (非正式，最常用)

pronunciationNotes.en: Very common informal greeting and parting phrase. "Ci" is pronounced like Chinese "q".
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 最常用的非正式问候语，见面和道别皆可用。“Ci”发音类似汉语拼音“q”。

exampleSentence.en: Hi Marco, how are you?

translations.zh-CN: 早上好 / 日安 (正式/通用)

pronunciationNotes.en: Compound of "buon" (good) and "giorno" (day). "gi" sounds like "ji".
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 由 buon（好）与 giorno（天）组成。“gi”在元音前发音近“j”。

exampleSentence.en: Good morning Mrs. Rossi!

translations.zh-CN: 晚上好

pronunciationNotes.en: Used from late afternoon onwards.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 通常在下午4-5点后使用。末尾“ra”需轻弹舌。

exampleSentence.en: Good evening everyone!

translations.zh-CN: 晚安 (睡前或深夜道别)

pronunciationNotes.en: Notice the double "tt" in "notte": hold the consonant briefly before releasing.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: “notte”中有双辅音“tt”，发音时要在闭合处略作停顿再爆破。

exampleSentence.en: I'm going to bed, good night!

translations.zh-CN: 谢谢 / 感谢

pronunciationNotes.en: "z" has a "ts" sound. Pronounce the final "e" crisply, do not drop it.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: “z”发清音“ts”（类似“呲”）。末尾“e”要清晰发音，不可吞音。

exampleSentence.en: Thank you for your help!

translations.en: Thank you very much (literally: a thousand thanks)
translations.zh-CN: 非常感谢 (字面：千倍感谢)

pronunciationNotes.en: Double "ll" in mille is elongated and pronounced against the upper alveolar ridge.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: “mille”的双辅音“ll”舌尖抵住上齿龈稍作拉长。

exampleSentence.en: Thank you very much for the gift!

translations.zh-CN: 不用谢 / 不客气 / 请

pronunciationNotes.en: Versatile word: standard reply to "Grazie", also used when offering something or holding a door.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 回答“Grazie”的标准用语；给人让路或递东西时亦表示“请”。

exampleSentence.en: Please, make yourself comfortable.

translations.zh-CN: 请 / 劳驾

pronunciationNotes.en: "Per piacere" is an equally valid alternative.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 用于礼貌请求。同义表达有“per piacere”或“per cortesia”。

exampleSentence.en: A coffee, please.

translations.zh-CN: 对不起 / 不好意思 (非正式，对熟人或同辈)

pronunciationNotes.en: Used when addressing someone you use "tu" with.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 用于非正式场合道歉或打断熟人。

exampleSentence.en: Sorry for being late!

translations.zh-CN: 打扰一下 / 请原谅 (正式，对陌生人或长辈)

pronunciationNotes.en: Used when attracting attention politely in public (e.g. asking a stranger for directions).
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 街头问路、餐厅叫侍者时最得体的称呼。

exampleSentence.en: Excuse me, do you know what time it is?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 打扰一下，请问现在几点了？

translations.zh-CN: 再见 / 后会有期

pronunciationNotes.en: Double "rr" requires an active alveolar trill. "ci" sounds like "qi".
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: “rr”需要发颤音。“ci”发音如“qi”。字面意思是“直到我们再次相见”。

exampleSentence.en: Thank you for everything and goodbye!

translations.zh-CN: 很高兴认识你 / 荣幸

pronunciationNotes.en: Standard greeting when introduced to someone for the first time.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 初次与人结识握手时的标准致辞。

exampleSentence.en: Nice to meet you!

translations.zh-CN: 你好吗？ / 最近怎么样？(非正式)

pronunciationNotes.en: Casual greeting asked to friends. 'Stai' has an open 'ai' diphthong.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 常用于熟人之间的问候。'stai'中s不送气，ai为双元音。

exampleSentence.en: Hi Giulia, how are you today?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你好茱莉亚，今天怎么样？

translations.en: I'm doing well / I am good
translations.zh-CN: 我很好 / 我挺好的

pronunciationNotes.en: Standard response to 'come stai?'. 'Bene' has an open 'e' sound.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 回答'come stai?'的标准用语。'bene'第一个e开口较大。

exampleSentence.en: I'm good, thanks, and you?

translations.zh-CN: 欢迎 (对单数男性或通用)

pronunciationNotes.en: Changes gender: benvenuta (female), benvenuti (plural). 'V' is a labiodental fricative.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 阳性单数形式，对女性用benvenuta，复数用benvenuti。'v'要咬下唇发音。

exampleSentence.en: Welcome to Italy!

translations.zh-CN: 一会儿见 / 待会儿见

pronunciationNotes.en: 'Presto' has a light trilled R and stress on the first syllable.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'presto'中pr需轻微颤音，重音在第一音节。

exampleSentence.it: È stato un piacere, a presto!
exampleSentence.en: It was a pleasure, see you soon!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 很高兴见到你，一会儿见！

translations.zh-CN: 回头见 / 待会儿见 (今天晚些时候)

pronunciationNotes.en: Used when you expect to see the person later the same day.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 专用于当天晚些时候还会见面的情况，o为纯元音。

exampleSentence.it: Vado a fare una telefonata, a dopo!
exampleSentence.en: I'm going to make a phone call, see you later!

translations.zh-CN: 明天见

pronunciationNotes.en: Stress on 'ma'. Clear pure 'i' at the end.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 重音在'ma'上，末尾i音清晰短促。

exampleSentence.it: La lezione è finita, a domani!
exampleSentence.en: The class is finished, see you tomorrow!

translations.zh-CN: 你叫什么名字？ (非正式)

pronunciationNotes.en: 'ch' sounds like 'k', followed by 'ia' (/kja/).
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 意语中'ch'发k音，'chi'类似汉语拼音'k+y'，不读'吃'。

exampleSentence.it: Piacere di conoscerti, come ti chiami?
exampleSentence.en: Nice to meet you, what's your name?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 很高兴认识你，你叫什么名字？

translations.zh-CN: 我叫... / 我的名字是...

pronunciationNotes.en: Standard introduction phrase. 'Ch' sounds like hard 'k'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 自我介绍必备短语。'ch'发硬音k。

exampleSentence.it: Mi chiamo Luca e studio a Roma.
exampleSentence.en: My name is Luca and I study in Rome.

translations.zh-CN: 你是哪里人？ / 你来自哪里？

pronunciationNotes.en: 'Sei' has a clear diphthong /ɛi/. 'V' requires lower lip contact.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'dove'的v需咬唇，'sei'类似汉语'晒'的读音但更清脆。

exampleSentence.it: Di dove sei? Io vengo da Pechino.
exampleSentence.en: Where are you from? I come from Beijing.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你是哪里人？我来自北京。

translations.zh-CN: 我是中国人

pronunciationNotes.en: 'ci' sounds like 'chee' (/tʃi/). 's' between vowels is voiced /z/.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'ci'发音同汉语拼音'q'，'nese'里的s在元音间发浊音z。

exampleSentence.it: Sono cinese, ma abito a Milano.
exampleSentence.en: I am Chinese, but I live in Milan.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我是中国人，但我住在米兰。

translations.zh-CN: 我是意大利人

pronunciationNotes.en: Feminine form is 'italiana'. Stress on 'lja'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 女性表述为'italiana'。注意't'不送气，重音在'lia'上。

exampleSentence.it: Lui è italiano, è nato a Firenze.
exampleSentence.en: He is Italian, he was born in Florence.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 他是意大利人，出生在佛罗伦萨。

translations.zh-CN: 祝你度过愉快的一天！

pronunciationNotes.en: Used when parting during daytime. 'G' before 'i' is soft /dʒ/.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 白天告别时的祝福。'gior'发音同拼音'jior'，r轻弹。

exampleSentence.en: Thanks for your help, have a good day!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 感谢你的帮助，祝你度过愉快的一天！

translations.zh-CN: 祝你度过愉快的夜晚！

pronunciationNotes.en: Used when parting in the evening before nightfall.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 傍晚告别时使用，区别于睡前道晚安的buonanotte。

exampleSentence.en: See you tomorrow, have a good evening!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 明天见，祝你度过愉快的夜晚！

translations.zh-CN: 周末愉快！

pronunciationNotes.en: Adopted English loanword combined with Italian 'buon'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 意大利人周五道别最常用的短语，借用英文weekend。

exampleSentence.it: Buon weekend a te e alla tua famiglia!
exampleSentence.en: Have a good weekend to you and your family!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 祝你和你的家人周末愉快！

translations.en: Have a good workday / Good shift!
translations.zh-CN: 工作顺利！ / 加油上班！

pronunciationNotes.en: Extremely common in bars, shops, and offices when leaving.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 意大利日常去咖啡吧、商店或同事上班时极其常用的礼貌祝语。

exampleSentence.en: Thanks for the coffee, have a good shift!

translations.zh-CN: 祝你好运

pronunciationNotes.en: Literal good luck phrase. Stress on 'tu'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 字面意义上的好运，重音在'tu'上。

exampleSentence.it: Buona fortuna per il tuo esame!
exampleSentence.en: Good luck on your exam!

translations.zh-CN: 祝你好运！ (地道成语，意为入狼之口)

pronunciationNotes.en: Double 'cc' in 'bocca' is held slightly longer.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 最地道的意式祝福。'bocca'双写cc需停顿发双辅音。

exampleSentence.it: Hai il colloquio oggi? In bocca al lupo!
exampleSentence.en: You have the interview today? Break a leg!

translations.en: Thanks! (Traditional response to 'in bocca al lupo')
translations.zh-CN: 谢谢！ (回应'in bocca al lupo'的标准回答)

pronunciationNotes.en: Never say 'grazie' to 'in bocca al lupo'! Say 'viva il lupo' (or 'crepi').
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 收到'in bocca al lupo'时绝不能说grazie，必须说viva il lupo或crepi。

exampleSentence.it: — In bocca al lupo! — Viva il lupo!
exampleSentence.en: — Break a leg! — Thanks!

translations.zh-CN: 衷心祝贺！ / 祝愿！

pronunciationNotes.en: Universal celebration phrase for holidays, anniversaries, and birthdays.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 全能庆祝用语，适用于节日、纪念日及生日。't'不送气。

exampleSentence.en: Best wishes for a Merry Christmas!

translations.zh-CN: 生日快乐！

pronunciationNotes.en: Double 'nn' must be held longer than single n.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'compleanno'的双写nn发音需拉长，重音在'an'。

exampleSentence.en: You're turning 20 today? Happy Birthday!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你今天二十岁了？生日快乐！

translations.zh-CN: 祝贺你！ / 恭喜！

pronunciationNotes.en: 'z' before 'io' is pronounced as strong double /tts/.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'zi'读作清脆的'ci'音(/ts/)，重音在'o'上。

exampleSentence.en: You passed the exam? Congratulations!

translations.zh-CN: 干杯！ / 保重！ (打喷嚏时的礼貌用语)

pronunciationNotes.en: Used both for toasting drinks and when someone sneezes.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 双重用途：既可作为祝酒词，又可在他人打喷嚏时表示'保重'。

exampleSentence.it: Salute a tutti noi e a questa bella serata!
exampleSentence.en: Cheers to all of us and to this lovely evening!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 为我们大家和这美妙的夜晚干杯！

translations.zh-CN: 干杯！ (碰杯声)

pronunciationNotes.en: Directly pronounced /tʃin tʃin/, miming the sound of glasses.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 最亲切的碰杯词，源自碰杯声，读音同汉语'亲亲'。

exampleSentence.en: Let's raise our glasses, cheers!

translations.zh-CN: 太抱歉了 / 非常对不起

pronunciationNotes.en: More emotional than simple 'scusa'. 's' in scusa is voiced /z/.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 比单纯的'scusa'更加真诚的道歉。'tanto'重音在tan。

exampleSentence.it: Sono arrivato in ritardo, scusami tanto!
exampleSentence.en: I arrived late, I am so sorry!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我迟到了，实在太对不起了！

translations.en: It doesn't matter / No problem / Never mind
translations.zh-CN: 没关系 / 没事儿 / 不碍事

pronunciationNotes.en: Literally 'does nothing'. Smoothly spoken together.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 字面意思'无所谓，不产生影响'，用来安慰对方不用道歉。

exampleSentence.it: Hai rovesciato un po' d'acqua? Non fa niente!
exampleSentence.en: You spilled some water? No problem at all!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 洒了点水？没关系，不碍事！

translations.zh-CN: 不客气 / 没什么

pronunciationNotes.en: Very common alternative to 'prego' when someone thanks you.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 日常回复'grazie'的高频短语，相当于'小事一桩'。

exampleSentence.it: — Grazie per il passaggio. — Di niente, figurati!
exampleSentence.en: — Thanks for the ride. — You're welcome!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: ——谢谢你载我一程。——客气啥，没事！

translations.zh-CN: 十分乐意 / 乐意至极

pronunciationNotes.en: 'Piacere' has soft 'ce' (/tʃe/). Very polite and friendly acceptance.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 礼貌接受邀请或帮助他人时的回答，展现亲切热诚。

exampleSentence.it: Vieni a cena stasera? — Con piacere!
exampleSentence.en: Are you coming to dinner tonight? — With pleasure!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 今晚来一起吃饭吗？——非常乐意！

translations.en: See you around / We'll see each other
translations.zh-CN: 回头见 / 我们晚点见

pronunciationNotes.en: 'Ci' sounds like 'chee'. Reflexive verb for 'seeing each other'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 熟人道别口头禅，'ci'发拼音q，'vediamo'重音在'dia'。

exampleSentence.it: Devo scappare adesso, ci vediamo dopo!
exampleSentence.en: I must run now, see you later!
